But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…

translations.web: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living.
translations.bsb: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
translations.kjv: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
translations.asv: God will likewise destroy thee for ever; He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. Selah
